title: Doctests are unit tests and long functions are split
body:
Doctests make up about 490 lines of `libsufr/src/sufr_file.rs` and about 220 lines of `libsufr/src/suffix_array.rs`, and the latter has no unit tests. Some doctests hardcode layout details such as `meta.file_size, 172` and `file_version, 6`. Several functions run past 80 lines: `SufrFile::read`, `set_suffix_array_mem` (126 lines), `subsample_suffix_array_by_text`, `list`, and the builder's `partition`, `sort`, `merge` (7 arguments) and `merge_sort` (6 arguments). `sufr/src/lib.rs` holds about 105 lines of commented-out tests. Names chosen during the earlier steps are provisional.

## Proposal

- Turn the doctests into unit tests next to the code they test.
- Rename where earlier steps left provisional names.
- Split the long functions listed above and reduce the argument counts of `merge` and `merge_sort`.
- Delete the commented-out tests in `sufr/src/lib.rs`.
- Run a comment pass under the `rust-comments` rules over every file the refactor touched.
